debut.episodeTitle: The Day a New Demon was Born

suzaku-kururugi.notes: Code Geass is an original anime, so there is no source chapter.
suzaku-kururugi.abilities: A Japanese-born Britannian soldier with superhuman reflexes and athleticism, and the pilot of the advanced Knightmare Frame Lancelot.

fate.detail: Suzaku is publicly declared dead, but he survives and wears the mask of Zero to kill Lelouch in the Zero Requiem (R2 episode 25), living on as Zero.

suzuha-amane.name: Suzuha Amane
suzuha-amane.role: Part-time worker for the landlord of the Future Gadget Laboratory's building
suzuha-amane.notes: Debut is in the first Steins;Gate series, not Steins;Gate 0. Steins;Gate is adapted from a visual novel, so source is null. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
suzuha-amane.abilities: A time traveller from a dystopian 2036 with excellent fighting skills, who works part-time at the shop below the lab and rides a bicycle everywhere.

fate.detail: On one Alpha world line she reaches 1975 with amnesia and later takes her own life out of guilt, which Okabe's D-Mail undoes; in the final Steins;Gate world line she is alive.

tachikoma.name: Tachikoma
tachikoma.role: AI-equipped multi-legged think tanks used by Public Security Section 9

debut.anime: Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex

tachikoma.notes: The role is confirmed by both sources. The episode 1 debut rests on Wikipedia; the Ghost in the Shell Wiki gives no first episode. Tachikomatic Days is a set of shorts that aired alongside Stand Alone Complex. The original manga has the earlier Fuchikoma design, so no manga chapter is given.
tachikoma.abilities: Spider-like AI think-tanks used by Section 9, armed with machine guns and grenade launchers, with thermo-optic camouflage and the habit of sharing memories each night.

fate.detail: In Stand Alone Complex episode 25 the three remaining Tachikoma sacrifice themselves to save Batou; their AIs survive on a satellite and they return in 2nd GIG.

takashi-komuro.name: Takashi Komuro
takashi-komuro.role: Protagonist; second-year student at Fujimi Academy who leads the survivors
takashi-komuro.notes: Wikipedia calls the school Fujimi High School; both sources cite chapter (Act) 1 for his opening scenes.
takashi-komuro.abilities: An ordinary student who becomes the group's leader in the zombie outbreak, fighting with a baseball bat and later firearms.

fate.detail: Takashi is alive at the end of the anime and of the manga, which was left unfinished after writer Daisuke Satō died in 2017.

takumi-aldini.name: Takumi Aldini
takumi-aldini.role: Transfer student from Florence at Totsuki Culinary Academy who specialises in Italian cuisine

debut.episodeTitle: A Concerto of Concept and Creation

takumi-aldini.notes: Episode 8 is his first full appearance (confirmed by both sources); the wiki also lists a cameo in episode 3 and chapter 4. Chapter 15 rests on the Shokugeki no Soma Wiki only.
takumi-aldini.abilities: An Italian chef from his family's trattoria, a specialist in Italian cuisine who works with a custom mezzaluna knife.

fate.detail: Takumi is alive at the end of the manga and anime.

tamaki-suoh.name: Tamaki Suou
tamaki-suoh.role: Co-founder and president of the Ouran Academy Host Club

debut.episodeTitle: Starting Today, You Are a Host!

tamaki-suoh.notes: Episode 1 is confirmed by both sources; chapter 1 rests on the Ouran Wiki. A manga-epilogue marriage is left out to avoid spoilers.
tamaki-suoh.abilities: The flamboyant founder and 'King' of the Host Club, whose charm makes him the club's top host; he is also a talented pianist.

fate.detail: Nobody dies in Ouran; Tamaki is alive at the end of the anime and manga.

tomura-shigaraki.name: Tomura Shigaraki
tomura-shigaraki.role: Leader of the League of Villains; main antagonist of the series
tomura-shigaraki.notes: Episode 8 and chapter 11 rest on the My Hero Academia Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 8 mentions unnamed villains, and Wikipedia cites chapter 13 for him leading the attack on the U.S.J. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
tomura-shigaraki.abilities: Leader of the League of Villains, whose Quirk, Decay, disintegrates anything he touches with all five fingers.

fate.detail: In the final battle Deku destroys All For One within him and his body disintegrates into ash (manga, 2024; anime final season, 2025).

tsubaki-sawabe.name: Tsubaki Sawabe
tsubaki-sawabe.role: Kousei Arima's childhood friend and next-door neighbour
tsubaki-sawabe.notes: Episode 1 is confirmed by both sources; chapter 1 ("Monotone") rests on the Your Lie in April Wiki.
tsubaki-sawabe.abilities: Kousei's athletic childhood friend, a member of the softball team.

fate.detail: Tsubaki survives the series; after Kaori's death she resolves to stay by Kousei's side.

tsutomu-goshiki.name: Tsutomu Goshiki
tsutomu-goshiki.role: First-year wing spiker and up-and-coming ace of Shiratorizawa Academy's volleyball team
tsutomu-goshiki.notes: The role is confirmed by both sources. Chapter 150 ("Greetings", volume 17 per Wikipedia's chapter list), where he appears unnamed, rests on the Haikyuu!! Wiki. Anime debut left blank: the wiki's character infobox gives Second Season episode 14 ("Growing Fast"), but that episode's own wiki page does not list him.
tsutomu-goshiki.abilities: Shiratorizawa's first-year wing spiker, with powerful straight and cross shots and a burning desire to become the team's ace.

fate.detail: Goshiki is alive at the end of the manga (chapter 402, 2020); Haikyu!! has no character deaths.

usopp.name: Usopp
usopp.role: Sniper of the Straw Hat Pirates

debut.episodeTitle: Who is the Victor? Devil Fruit Power Showdown!

usopp.notes: Chapter 23 is confirmed by both sources. Episode 8 rests on the One Piece Wiki; the Wikipedia summaries first name him in episode 9. Arcs are from the wiki's pre-timeskip history page.
usopp.abilities: The Straw Hats' sniper and a habitual liar, a sharpshooter with a slingshot who invents trick ammunition and gadgets.

fate.detail: Usopp is alive in the anime and the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

vanessa-enoteca.name: Vanessa Enoteca
vanessa-enoteca.role: Witch and Black Bulls member who uses Thread Magic
vanessa-enoteca.notes: Episode 6 and chapter 3 rest on the Black Clover Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 6 mentions two fighting Black Bulls without naming them. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
vanessa-enoteca.abilities: A Black Bulls mage whose Thread Magic binds enemies and lets her move allies like puppets.

fate.detail: Vanessa is alive in the anime and in the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

yato.name: Yato
yato.role: Stray god who takes on any wish for a five-yen offering as a "delivery god"

debut.episodeTitle: A Housecat, a Stray God, and a Tail

yato.notes: Chapter 1 per the wiki; Wikipedia confirms he is on the volume 1 cover. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
yato.abilities: Once a god of calamity, now a minor shrine-less god who takes any wish for 5 yen; a deadly swordsman when wielding his Regalia (Shinki) as a blade, he can cut phantoms and even people's ties.

fate.detail: Yato is alive at the end of the Noragami manga (concluded 2023) and in the anime.

yotsuha-miyamizu.name: Yotsuha Miyamizu
yotsuha-miyamizu.notes: Kimi no Na wa. (Your Name) is a 2016 original film, so episode and source chapter are null. An in-law relation shown only after the story is left out to avoid spoilers.
yotsuha-miyamizu.abilities: Mitsuha's sharp, cheeky younger sister, who helps at the family shrine.

fate.detail: In the original timeline she dies when the comet destroys Itomori in 2013, but after the evacuation that Taki sets in motion she survives and appears as a teenager in the epilogue.

yui-hirasawa.name: Yui Hirasawa
yui-hirasawa.role: Lead guitarist and vocalist of the Sakuragaoka High School Light Music Club
affiliations: Sakuragaoka High School Light Music Club
yui-hirasawa.notes: The manga debut is volume 1; Wikipedia confirms she is on the volume 1 cover. Chapter left blank because the wiki labels it chapter 0.
yui-hirasawa.abilities: A carefree, clumsy girl who joins the Light Music Club with no experience and turns out to learn the guitar quickly, with a good ear (perfect pitch); she plays her guitar 'Gīta' (a Gibson Les Paul).

fate.detail: Nobody dies in K-On!; Yui is alive at the end of the anime and manga.

yuno-kurosurii.name: Yuno
yuno-kurosurii.role: Asta's rival and fellow orphan from Hage; Golden Dawn Magic Knight
arcs: Eye of the Midnight Sun Encounter
yuno-kurosurii.notes: Chapter 1 per the wiki; Wikipedia confirms he is on the volume 1 cover. He also appears in the 2016 Jump Festa special. His birth family is left out to avoid spoilers.
yuno-kurosurii.abilities: Asta's fellow orphan and rival, a prodigy mage whose Wind Magic is strengthened when he receives a legendary four-leaf grimoire and the wind spirit Sylph.

fate.detail: Yuno is alive in the anime and in the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

yuriko-aoki.name: Yuriko Aoki
yuriko-aoki.role: Manga artist, pen name Ko Aoki, who moves from shōjo to Weekly Shōnen Jump
yuriko-aoki.notes: Her Hideout Door partner is Takuro Nakai. A later engagement is left out to avoid spoilers.
yuriko-aoki.abilities: A talented manga writer with a strong literary, novel-like style of storytelling, though she struggles at first with drawing and pacing for a weekly series.

fate.detail: Nobody dies in Bakuman; Aoki is alive at the end of the manga and anime.

zeke-5bb8f171-4101-4129-9b75-7d516ef3753.name: Zeke
zeke-5bb8f171-4101-4129-9b75-7d516ef3753.role: War chief of Marley's Warrior Unit and holder of the Beast Titan
zeke-5bb8f171-4101-4129-9b75-7d516ef3753.notes: Season 2 episode 1 is episode 26 overall; Wikipedia's summary has the Beast Titan appear there. Chapter 34 ("Soldiers Dance", end of volume 8) rests on the Attack on Titan Wiki; Wikipedia only says he is introduced around volume 9. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
zeke-5bb8f171-4101-4129-9b75-7d516ef3753.abilities: The Beast Titan: a large ape-like Titan that can speak, command mindless Titans and hurl boulders with deadly accuracy.

fate.detail: During the final battle, Levi decapitates him after he emerges from Eren's Titan (manga chapter 137; anime Final Chapters Special 2, 2023).

jujutsu-kaisen-satoru-gojou.name: Satoru Gojou
jujutsu-kaisen-satoru-gojou.role: Special grade jujutsu sorcerer and teacher at Tokyo Jujutsu High; Megumi Fushiguro's mentor
jujutsu-kaisen-satoru-gojou.notes: Both sources agree he first appeared in chapter 1 of the prequel Jujutsu Kaisen 0 (2017). The main-series chapter 1 rests on the Jujutsu Kaisen Wiki, which says he is only heard and seen on the cover there and appears in full in chapter 2. Episode 1 rests on the wiki; the Wikipedia summaries first name him in episode 2. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
jujutsu-kaisen-satoru-gojou.abilities: Called the strongest jujutsu sorcerer, he has the Limitless technique, an untouchable barrier of 'infinity', and the Six Eyes, which let him perceive cursed energy in fine detail.

fate.detail: Gojo is sealed in the Prison Realm during the Shibuya Incident (anime season 2), freed later, and then killed by Sukuna in their duel in manga chapter 236 (2023); the anime has not reached that chapter as of November 2026.

luffy-monkey-d.name: Monkey D. Luffy
luffy-monkey-d.role: Protagonist; captain of the Straw Hat Pirates who wants to become King of the Pirates

debut.episodeTitle: I'm Gonna Be King of the Pirates!

luffy-monkey-d.notes: Arcs listed are the East Blue arcs; he is in every arc of the series. Episode title as in the Wikipedia season 1 list. Family left out to avoid spoilers.
luffy-monkey-d.abilities: He ate the Gum-Gum Fruit, which gave him a stretchy rubber body that he uses for punches and kicks, backed by huge strength and resilience.

fate.detail: Luffy is alive in the anime and in the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

zoro-roronoa.name: Roronoa Zoro
zoro-roronoa.role: Swordsman of the Straw Hat Pirates; former pirate hunter

debut.episodeTitle: I'm Gonna Be King of the Pirates!

zoro-roronoa.notes: Chapter 3 ("Introducing Pirate Hunter Zoro") is confirmed by both sources. Episode 1 rests on the One Piece Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 1 does not name him. Arcs listed are the East Blue arcs. Family left out.
zoro-roronoa.abilities: A master swordsman who fights with his three-sword style, holding a third blade in his mouth, and aims to become the world's greatest swordsman; he has a terrible sense of direction.

fate.detail: Zoro is alive in the anime and the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

arataka-reigen.name: Arataka Reigen
arataka-reigen.role: Self-proclaimed psychic who runs the Spirits and Such Consultation Office; Mob's boss and mentor
arataka-reigen.notes: Episode 1 is confirmed by both sources. Chapter 1 rests on the Mob Psycho 100 Wiki; Wikipedia's character list gives no chapter.
arataka-reigen.abilities: A self-proclaimed great psychic with no real powers, who gets by on charisma, quick talk, common sense, table salt and genuinely good massages.

fate.detail: Reigen is alive at the end of the manga (2017) and the anime's third season (2022).

guts.name: Guts
guts.role: Protagonist; wandering swordsman known as the Black Swordsman
guts.notes: Episode 1 is confirmed by both sources. His manga debut is the opening "The Black Swordsman" chapter, which Wikipedia numbers A0 and the Berserk Wiki numbers 0-1, so chapter is null. The 1997 anime covers only the Black Swordsman and Golden Age arcs; arc names follow the Berserk Wiki. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
guts.abilities: A hardened mercenary of extraordinary strength and battle experience who swings a huge greatsword that ordinary men cannot even lift.

fate.detail: Guts survives the Eclipse at the end of the 1997 anime, losing an arm and an eye, and is alive in the ongoing manga (continued by Studio Gaga after Kentaro Miura's death).

chainsaw-man-makima.name: Makima
chainsaw-man-makima.role: High-ranking Public Safety Devil Hunter who takes Denji in and recruits him
chainsaw-man-makima.notes: Relatives and her other affiliations are left out to avoid spoilers.
chainsaw-man-makima.abilities: A high-ranking Public Safety devil hunter and Denji's boss, who commands contracted devils and can kill targets from a distance just by pointing and saying 'bang'.

fate.detail: In the climax of Part 1 (manga chapters 96-97, 2020), Denji kills her with a chainsaw made from Power's blood and eats her to get around her immortality; the Control Devil is reborn as a girl named Nayuta. The anime has not reached this yet.

mai-sakurajima.name: Mai Sakurajima
mai-sakurajima.role: Teenage actress at Sakuta's high school whom he meets in a library dressed as a bunny girl, unseen by everyone else

debut.anime: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai
debut.episodeTitle: My Senpai is a Bunny Girl

mai-sakurajima.notes: Light novel volume 1 per the Rascal Does Not Dream Wiki; Wikipedia confirms she is on the volume 1 cover. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
mai-sakurajima.abilities: A famous teenage actress on hiatus who becomes invisible to everyone around her because of Adolescence Syndrome; she is also a strong student and quick-witted.

fate.detail: In the film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl (2019), Mai is killed by a car while saving Sakuta, but Sakuta changes the past with Shoko's help so the accident never happens; she is alive afterwards.

chainsaw-man-denji.name: Denji
chainsaw-man-denji.role: Protagonist; indebted young devil hunter who merges with his chainsaw devil Pochita
chainsaw-man-denji.notes: Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
chainsaw-man-denji.abilities: Fused with the Chainsaw Devil Pochita, he becomes Chainsaw Man when he pulls the cord on his chest, sprouting chainsaws from his head and arms, and recovers from injuries by drinking blood.

fate.detail: He is killed by the Zombie Devil's yakuza in the first chapter and episode, and revived when Pochita becomes his heart; he is alive in the latest manga chapters (as of November 2026), where Pochita erases himself to create a new timeline as Denji is being killed.

shigeo-kageyama.name: Shigeo Kageyama
shigeo-kageyama.role: Protagonist; middle schooler nicknamed Mob who holds immense psychic power and suppresses his emotions
shigeo-kageyama.abilities: An immensely powerful esper with telekinesis and exorcism skills who suppresses his emotions; if his feelings reach 100 percent, his power explodes uncontrollably.

fate.detail: Mob is alive at the end of the manga (2017) and the anime's third season (2022).

chainsaw-man-power.name: Power
chainsaw-man-power.role: Blood Fiend and Public Safety Devil Hunter assigned as Denji's partner
chainsaw-man-power.abilities: A Blood Fiend who shapes her own blood into weapons such as hammers and scythes, and is as reckless as she is strong.

fate.detail: Makima kills her (manga chapter 81, Part 1); her Blood Devil form briefly returns to give Denji her blood, and in the new timeline Pochita creates in Part 2 she is alive again. The anime has not reached her death yet.

violet-evergarden.name: Violet Evergarden
violet-evergarden.role: Protagonist; former child soldier who becomes an Auto Memory Doll writing letters for clients

debut.episodeTitle: "I Love You" and Auto Memory Dolls

violet-evergarden.notes: Light novel volume 1 per the Violet Evergarden Wiki; she is the title character of the first volume (Wikipedia). Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
violet-evergarden.abilities: A former child soldier with formidable combat skills and mechanical prosthetic arms, who becomes an Auto Memory Doll writing letters for clients.

fate.detail: Violet survives the series and the 2020 film, which ends with her staying on Ecarte Island with Gilbert.

edward-elric.name: Edward Elric
edward-elric.role: Protagonist; State Alchemist known as the Fullmetal Alchemist who searches for the Philosopher's Stone with his brother
edward-elric.abilities: The youngest State Alchemist, known as the Fullmetal Alchemist, who can transmute without a circle and fights with an automail right arm and left leg.

fate.detail: Edward survives; he gives up his ability to use alchemy to bring Al back (manga chapter 108; Brotherhood episode 63) and starts a family with Winry.

sakura-matou.name: Sakura Matou
sakura-matou.role: Younger daughter of the Tohsaka family who has been adopted into the Matou family
sakura-matou.notes: Episode 1 is confirmed by the Wikipedia episode summary and a TYPE-MOON Wiki quote attributed to Fate/Zero episode 1. She first appeared in the Fate/stay night visual novel (2004); Fate/Zero light novel volume and chapter not confirmed.
sakura-matou.abilities: A young girl adopted into the Matou family of mages, which abuses her with crest worms to adapt her to its magic.

fate.detail: Sakura survives Fate/Zero; in the sequel Fate/stay night her fate depends on the route, and she survives the Heaven's Feel route's True End.

jujutsu-kaisen-megumi-fushiguro.name: Megumi Fushiguro
jujutsu-kaisen-megumi-fushiguro.role: First-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who fights with shikigami summoned from shadows
jujutsu-kaisen-megumi-fushiguro.notes: Other relatives are left out to avoid spoilers.
jujutsu-kaisen-megumi-fushiguro.abilities: A first-year sorcerer who uses the Ten Shadows Technique to summon shikigami, such as his Divine Dogs, from shadows through hand signs.

fate.detail: Sukuna takes over his body during the Culling Game and keeps it until Yuji frees him in the Shinjuku Showdown; Megumi survives to the series' end (manga chapter 271, 2024).

joseph-joestar.name: Joseph Joestar
joseph-joestar.role: Protagonist of Part 2, Battle Tendency; Jonathan Joestar's grandson, living in New York
joseph-joestar.notes: Chapter 45 ("New York's JoJo") is the first chapter of Battle Tendency. He returns as an older ally in Part 3, Stardust Crusaders. His mother and descendants are left out to avoid spoilers.
joseph-joestar.abilities: A brash, cunning Hamon user who predicts his opponents' words ('Your next line is...') and wins through tricks and improvised weapons such as clackers.

fate.detail: In Part 3, Stardust Crusaders, DIO drains his blood and Joseph dies, but Jotaro revives him with a transfusion of DIO's blood; he lives on as an old man in later parts.

shouto-todoroki.name: Shouto Todoroki
shouto-todoroki.role: Student in U.A. High School's Class 1-A who can create ice and fire

debut.episodeTitle: What I Can Do For Now

shouto-todoroki.notes: Chapter 6 is confirmed by both sources. Episode 5 rests on the My Hero Academia Wiki; the Wikipedia summaries of episodes 5 and 6 do not name him. His father is the pro hero Endeavor; other relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
shouto-todoroki.abilities: His Quirk, Half-Cold Half-Hot, creates ice from his right side and fire from his left, though at first he refuses to use his fire.

fate.detail: Todoroki survives the final war against Dabi and is alive at the series' end (manga final chapter 430, 2024).

megumin.name: Megumin
megumin.role: Crimson Demon archwizard who only uses Explosion magic; joins Kazuma's party

debut.anime: Kono Subarashii Sekai ni Shukufuku wo!

megumin.notes: Episode 2 is confirmed by both sources. Light novel volume 1 rests on the KonoSuba Wiki.
megumin.abilities: An Arch-wizard of the Crimson Demon clan who knows only one spell, Explosion, which she can cast once a day before collapsing.

fate.detail: Megumin is alive in the anime and at the end of the main light novel series (2020).

rem-3.name: Rem
rem-3.role: Maid at Roswaal L. Mathers's mansion and twin sister of Ram
rem-3.notes: Episode 4 is confirmed by both sources. Light novel volume 2 rests on the Re:Zero Wiki; Wikipedia gives her web novel debut chapter, "The Road to Redemption Begins". Parents left out to avoid spoilers.
rem-3.abilities: A maid of the Roswaal mansion and an oni who fights with a flail called the Morning Star, uses water magic and can enter a powerful oni form.

fate.detail: Rem is killed in timelines that Subaru resets with Return by Death, and falls into a coma after Gluttony eats her name and memories (season 2, episode 1); she is not dead, and in the ongoing light novels she wakes at the end of Arc 6.

gintoki-sakata.name: Gintoki Sakata
gintoki-sakata.role: Protagonist; silver-haired samurai who runs the Yorozuya odd-jobs business in Edo

debut.episodeTitle: You Guys!! Do You Even Have Gintama?!

gintoki-sakata.notes: Episodes 1 and 2 aired together as a one-hour anime-original special; the first manga chapter (Lesson 1, "Nobody with Natural Wavy Hair Can Be That Bad") is adapted in episode 3. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
gintoki-sakata.abilities: A lazy, sweet-toothed freelancer who is secretly a legendary samurai from the Joui War, fighting with a wooden sword with superhuman skill.

fate.detail: Gintoki is alive at the end of the manga (2019) and the anime's final film, Gintama: The Final (2021).

subaru-natsuki.name: Subaru Natsuki
subaru-natsuki.role: Protagonist; teenager suddenly transported to another world on his way home from a convenience store

debut.episodeTitle: The End of the Beginning and the Beginning of the End

subaru-natsuki.notes: Light novel volume 1 per the Re:Zero Wiki; Wikipedia gives his web novel debut in the prologue (2014). Relatives left out.
subaru-natsuki.abilities: He has no combat skills, but his power 'Return by Death' sends him back to an earlier checkpoint with his memories whenever he dies.

fate.detail: He dies many times starting in the first arc, each time returning to a checkpoint through Return by Death; he is alive in the anime and the ongoing light novels.

ichigo-f875b8ab-821d-4659-8d8e-5f79e5fd3.name: Ichigo
ichigo-f875b8ab-821d-4659-8d8e-5f79e5fd3.role: Leader of Squad 13 and pistil who pilots the Franxx Delphinium with Goro
ichigo-f875b8ab-821d-4659-8d8e-5f79e5fd3.notes: Darling in the Franxx is an original anime (the manga runs alongside it), so source is null. Episode 1 rests on the Darling in the Franxx Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 1 does not name her. Code number 015 (both sources). Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
ichigo-f875b8ab-821d-4659-8d8e-5f79e5fd3.abilities: Squad 13's leader and a FRANXX pilot (Delphinium, partnered with Goro), a capable and level-headed pilot who coordinates the team in battle.

fate.detail: Ichigo survives the series; the final episode shows her married to Goro and expecting their first child.

kiyotaka-ayanokouji.name: Kiyotaka Ayanokouji
kiyotaka-ayanokouji.role: Protagonist; quiet, low-key student in Class 1-D at the Advanced Nurturing High School

debut.anime: Youkoso Jitsuryoku Shijou Shugi no Kyoushitsu e
debut.episodeTitle: What is Evil? Whatever Springs from Weakness.

kiyotaka-ayanokouji.notes: Light novel volume 1 per the Classroom of the Elite Wiki; Wikipedia's episode 1 summary introduces him joining Class 1-D. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
kiyotaka-ayanokouji.abilities: A seemingly average student of Class D who deliberately hides his intellect, physical strength and skill at manipulating others, scoring exactly 50 points on every exam.

fate.detail: Ayanokouji is alive in the anime and in the ongoing light novels.

zero-two.name: Zero Two
zero-two.role: Horned pistil known as the "Partner Killer" who pairs with Hiro to pilot the Franxx Strelizia
zero-two.notes: Darling in the Franxx is an original anime (the Kentaro Yabuki manga runs alongside it), so source is null. Her code is 002. Relatives and affiliations left out to avoid spoilers.
zero-two.abilities: An elite FRANXX pilot with klaxosaur blood, nicknamed the 'Partner Killer' because no co-pilot had survived three rides with her, who pilots Strelizia with Hiro.

fate.detail: In the anime's final episode (24), Zero Two and Hiro sacrifice themselves to destroy the VIRM homeworld and are implied to be reincarnated on Earth much later; in the manga adaptation she survives.

hitagi-senjougahara.name: Hitagi Senjougahara
hitagi-senjougahara.role: Koyomi Araragi's classmate, afflicted by an oddity that has taken away her weight
hitagi-senjougahara.notes: Wikipedia titles episode 1 "Hitagi Crab, Part One". She debuts in "Hitagi Crab", the first story of the Bakemonogatari light novel; volume and chapter numbers not confirmed. Relatives left out.
hitagi-senjougahara.abilities: A sharp-tongued girl who has lost almost all her weight to an apparition, the Heavy Stone Crab; she defends herself with stationery such as staplers and box cutters.

fate.detail: Hitagi is alive throughout the Monogatari series and later appears as an adult.

shouyou-hinata.name: Shouyou Hinata
shouyou-hinata.role: Protagonist; short middle blocker with a huge jump on Karasuno High's volleyball team
shouyou-hinata.notes: Chapter 1 is "Endings and Beginnings" (both sources). Arc names follow the Haikyu!! Wiki.
shouyou-hinata.abilities: A short middle blocker with incredible jumping power, speed and stamina, known for the lightning-fast 'freak quick' attack with Kageyama.

fate.detail: Nobody dies in Haikyu!!; the epilogue shows Hinata playing beach volleyball in Brazil, then professionally for the MSBY Black Jackals in Japan's V.League and later Asas São Paulo.

ichigo-kurosaki.name: Ichigo Kurosaki
ichigo-kurosaki.role: Protagonist; teenager who can see ghosts and gains the powers of a Shinigami

debut.episodeTitle: The Day I Became a Shinigami

ichigo-kurosaki.notes: Chapter 1 is "Death & Strawberry" (Wikipedia; the Bleach Wiki places it in volume 1). Other relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
ichigo-kurosaki.abilities: A teenager who can see ghosts and gains Soul Reaper powers from Rukia, fighting with his oversized Zanpakuto, Zangetsu.

fate.detail: In Hueco Mundo, Ulquiorra blasts a hole through his chest and kills him (anime episode 271), but he revives in a rampaging Hollow form when Orihime cries for help; he survives the series and is married to Orihime in the final chapter (686).

asuka-langley.name: Asuka Langley Souryuu
asuka-langley.role: Pilot of Evangelion Unit-02 who transfers to Japan from Germany
asuka-langley.notes: Episode 8 is confirmed by both sources; the Wikipedia episode list renders its title "Asuka Arrives in Japan". Neon Genesis Evangelion is an original anime, so source is null; she first appears in volume 4 of the Sadamoto manga. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
asuka-langley.abilities: A confident, highly trained Eva pilot who pilots Evangelion Unit-02 with aggressive skill and graduated from university at a young age.

fate.detail: In The End of Evangelion (1997), Unit-02 is torn apart by the Mass Production Evangelions, but Asuka is alive beside Shinji in the final scene.

spike-spiegel.name: Spike Spiegel
spike-spiegel.role: Protagonist; laid-back bounty hunter aboard the spaceship Bebop
spike-spiegel.notes: Cowboy Bebop is an original anime, so source is null. "Asteroid Blues" is session 1 in the series order; the 1998 TV Tokyo broadcast aired "Stray Dog Strut" first (Wikipedia). His past is left out to avoid spoilers.
spike-spiegel.abilities: A laid-back bounty hunter and former syndicate hitman, an expert in Jeet Kune Do, a sharpshooter, and the pilot of the Swordfish II.

fate.detail: After killing Vicious in the final session ('The Real Folk Blues Part 2'), Spike collapses on the stairs; the series leaves whether he dies deliberately ambiguous.

shinobu-oshino.name: Shinobu Oshino
shinobu-oshino.role: Silent blonde girl who lives in the abandoned cram school with Meme Oshino
shinobu-oshino.notes: Episode 1 rests on the Monogatari Wiki episode page; the Wikipedia summaries first name her in later episodes. She first appears in the Bakemonogatari light novel ("Hitagi Crab"); volume and chapter not confirmed. Her past and relationship to Koyomi are left out to avoid spoilers.
shinobu-oshino.abilities: The weakened remnant of a once-powerful vampire, Kiss-shot Acerola-Orion Heart-Under-Blade, who lives in Koyomi's shadow and regains strength by drinking his blood.

fate.detail: Shinobu is alive in the anime and the ongoing Monogatari novels, bound to Koyomi.

jujutsu-kaisen-kento-nanami.name: Kento Nanami
jujutsu-kaisen-kento-nanami.role: Grade 1 jujutsu sorcerer and former salaryman who works alongside Yuji Itadori
jujutsu-kaisen-kento-nanami.notes: Episode 8 and chapter 18 rest on the Jujutsu Kaisen Wiki; the Wikipedia summaries first name him in episode 9, "Small Fry and Reverse Retribution".
jujutsu-kaisen-kento-nanami.abilities: A Grade 1 sorcerer whose Ratio Technique creates a weak point at a 7:3 point on any target, and who grows stronger by working overtime under a binding vow.

fate.detail: During the Shibuya Incident, badly burned by Jogo, he is killed by Mahito (manga chapter 120; anime season 2 episode 18).

rimuru-tempest.name: Rimuru Tempest
rimuru-tempest.role: Protagonist; office worker reborn as a slime in another world who befriends the Storm Dragon Veldora
rimuru-tempest.notes: Light novel volume 1 per the Tensura Wiki; the series began as a web novel. In his previous life he was Satoru Mikami (Wikipedia episode 1 summary). Manga debut is chapter 1, "Death and Reincarnation" (wiki).
rimuru-tempest.abilities: A slime who can devour anything with his Predator skill and copy its abilities, aided by the analytical skill Great Sage.

fate.detail: Rimuru is alive in the anime and the ongoing light novels; his past life as Satoru Mikami ended when he was stabbed in episode 1, which is how he was reborn as a slime.

sasuke-uchiha.name: Sasuke Uchiha
sasuke-uchiha.role: Member of Team 7 and one of the last of the Uchiha clan; Naruto's rival
sasuke-uchiha.notes: Chapter 3 ("Enter Sasuke!") is confirmed by both sources. Episode 1 rests on Narutopedia; the Wikipedia summaries first name him in episode 3, "Sasuke and Sakura: Friends or Foes?". Arcs listed are Part I arcs; later arcs and his own family left out to avoid spoilers.
sasuke-uchiha.abilities: A prodigy of the Uchiha clan and the top student of his class, skilled with fire-style ninjutsu, shuriken and taijutsu, who awakens his Sharingan in the Land of Waves.

fate.detail: Sasuke survives the series; in the final arc he is gravely wounded by Madara but saved, and the epilogue shows him married to Sakura with a daughter, Sarada.

erwin-smith.name: Erwin Smith

debut.episodeTitle: To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 1

erwin-smith.notes: Episode 1 and chapter 1 ("To You, 2,000 Years From Now") rest on the Attack on Titan Wiki; Wikipedia's episode 1 summary does not name him. Wikipedia confirms he succeeds Keith Shadis as commander.
erwin-smith.abilities: The 13th Commander of the Survey Corps, a brilliant strategist who created the Long-Range Scouting Formation that cut the Corps' losses outside the walls.

fate.detail: Erwin is mortally wounded leading a suicide charge against the Beast Titan in the Return to Shiganshina arc (anime season 3 part 2), and Levi chooses to give the Titan serum to Armin instead, letting him die.

hachiman-hikigaya.name: Hachiman Hikigaya
hachiman-hikigaya.role: Protagonist; cynical loner at Sobu High School who is made to join the Service Club

debut.anime: Yahari Ore no Seishun Love Comedy wa Machigatteiru.
debut.episodeTitle: Youth Romantic Comedy Is Wrong, as I Expected

hachiman-hikigaya.notes: Episode title as in the Wikipedia episode list; the Oregairu Wiki calls episode 1 "And Thus Their Mistaken Youth Begins." Light novel volume 1, chapter 1 per the wiki.
hachiman-hikigaya.abilities: A cynical loner with sharp observational skills, who solves the Service Club's problems in unconventional and often self-sacrificing ways.

fate.detail: Hachiman is alive at the end of the light novels and the anime's third season (2020); the series is a romantic comedy with no character deaths.

koyomi-araragi.name: Koyomi Araragi
koyomi-araragi.role: Protagonist; third-year at Naoetsu Private High School who helps girls afflicted by oddities
koyomi-araragi.notes: Wikipedia titles episode 1 "Hitagi Crab, Part One". First appears in the Bakemonogatari light novel (2006); volume and chapter not confirmed.
koyomi-araragi.abilities: A high-schooler who was once turned into a vampire and kept some vampiric traits, chiefly rapid healing, which he uses to help girls troubled by apparitions.

fate.detail: Izuko Gaen kills him in Owarimonogatari (Mayoi Hell), sending him to hell, where he meets Mayoi before coming back to life; he is alive afterwards.

akemi-homura.name: Homura Akemi
akemi-homura.role: Mysterious transfer student at Mitakihara Middle School who is a magical girl

debut.episodeTitle: I First Met Her in a Dream... or Something.

akemi-homura.notes: Madoka Magica is an original anime (the manga adapts it), so source is null. Her article renders the episode title "As If I Met Her in My Dream...". Her past is left out to avoid spoilers.
akemi-homura.abilities: A mysterious transfer student and magical girl who fights with guns and explosives and seems to know what will happen before it does.

fate.detail: Homura survives the TV series and the film Rebellion (2013), at the end of which she becomes a demon-like being who rewrites the world.

saber.name: Artoria Pendragon
saber.role: Saber-class Servant summoned by Kiritsugu Emiya for the Fourth Holy Grail War
saber.notes: Episode 1 rests on the Wikipedia episode summary; the TYPE-MOON Wiki gives no episode. She first appeared in the Fate/stay night visual novel (2004); Fate/Zero light novel volume not confirmed. Usually called Saber.
saber.abilities: Saber-class Servant King Arthur, a master swordswoman wielding the invisible sword Excalibur, whose true name release unleashes a devastating beam of light.

fate.detail: She is a hero who is dying at the Battle of Camlann: at the end of Fate/Zero she is forced to destroy the Grail and returns to that moment, and in Fate/stay night's Fate route she finally accepts her death there.

jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.name: Sukuna
jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.role: The King of Curses; ancient sorcerer whose twenty severed fingers survive as cursed objects
jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.notes: Full name Ryomen Sukuna. Relatives and later events left out to avoid spoilers.
jujutsu-kaisen-sukuna.abilities: The King of Curses, sealed in Yuji Itadori's body after Yuji eats one of his fingers; he regenerates and slices targets apart with invisible slashes.

fate.detail: Yuji defeats him in the Shinjuku Showdown; he accepts his defeat and his soul fades away in manga chapter 268 (2024). The anime has not reached this yet.

rei-ayanami.name: Rei Ayanami
rei-ayanami.notes: Neon Genesis Evangelion is an original anime, so source is null; Wikipedia notes the Sadamoto manga, published first, introduces her in chapter 2 ("Reunion"). Her background is left out to avoid spoilers.
rei-ayanami.abilities: The First Child, a quiet, emotionless pilot of Evangelion Unit-00 who follows Commander Ikari's orders without question.

fate.detail: In episode 23, "Rei III", she self-destructs Unit-00 to destroy the Angel Armisael and save Shinji; a new clone, the third Rei, replaces her.

johan-liebert.name: Johan Liebert
johan-liebert.role: Boy whose life Dr. Kenzo Tenma saves after he is shot in the head
johan-liebert.notes: Episode 1 is confirmed by the Wikipedia episode summary. Chapter 1 rests on the Wikipedia character list (Tenma saves him at the start of the story); no Monster fan wiki could be reached, and the chapter number was not confirmed by a second source. Everything else left out to avoid spoilers.
johan-liebert.abilities: Extraordinarily intelligent and charismatic, he wins people's trust and manipulates them into doing what he wants.

fate.detail: Johan is shot in the head in Ruhenheim during the finale but survives; the final episode (74) ends with his hospital bed empty.

misato-katsuragi.name: Misato Katsuragi
misato-katsuragi.role: Nerv officer who takes Shinji Ikari in as her ward
misato-katsuragi.notes: Neon Genesis Evangelion is an original anime, so source is null; Wikipedia notes she also opens chapter 1 ("Angel Attack") of the Sadamoto manga, published first. Her background is left out to avoid spoilers.
misato-katsuragi.abilities: NERV's Operations Director, a bold tactical commander who plans the battles against the Angels; at home she is Shinji's messy, beer-loving guardian.

fate.detail: In The End of Evangelion (1997), she is shot while getting Shinji to Unit-01, gives him her cross pendant and dies in an explosion.

yami-sukehiro.name: Yami Sukehiro
yami-sukehiro.role: Captain of the Black Bulls, the Magic Knights squad Asta joins
yami-sukehiro.notes: Chapter 2 ("The Magic Knights Entrance Exam") is confirmed by both sources. Episode 4 rests on the Black Clover Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 4 does not name him. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
yami-sukehiro.abilities: Captain of the Black Bulls, a swordsman whose Dark Magic lets his katana cut through almost anything, and who can sense opponents' movements through 'ki'.

fate.detail: Yami is alive in the anime and in the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

shouya-ishida.name: Shouya Ishida
shouya-ishida.role: Protagonist; former elementary school bully who seeks to reconnect with Shouko Nishimiya, a deaf girl he tormented
shouya-ishida.notes: There is no TV anime: Koe no Katachi (A Silent Voice) is a 2016 film, so episode is null. Chapter 1 per the Koe no Katachi Wiki; Wikipedia confirms he is on the volume 1 cover and opens the story. Mother named in the wiki infobox and the Wikipedia character list.
shouya-ishida.abilities: As a child, a reckless, thrill-seeking bully; as a teenager, a withdrawn loner who learns sign language to communicate with Shouko.

fate.detail: Shouya survives; he falls into a river saving Shouko and is in a coma for a while, but recovers.

sakuta-azusagawa.name: Sakuta Azusagawa
sakuta-azusagawa.role: Protagonist; high school student who looks into cases of Adolescence Syndrome after meeting Mai Sakurajima

debut.anime: Seishun Buta Yarou wa Bunny Girl Senpai no Yume wo Minai
debut.episodeTitle: My Senpai is a Bunny Girl

sakuta-azusagawa.notes: Light novel volume 1 per the Rascal Does Not Dream Wiki; Wikipedia's synopsis of the first volume centres on him. Other family left out to avoid spoilers.
sakuta-azusagawa.abilities: A deadpan, blunt-spoken high schooler who helps girls affected by 'Adolescence Syndrome', starting with Mai Sakurajima.

fate.detail: In the film Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dreaming Girl (2019) there is a timeline in which he is killed in a traffic accident, but Shoko changes the past so that he survives; he is alive in the ongoing series.

yuu-nishinoya.name: Yuu Nishinoya
yuu-nishinoya.role: Second-year libero of Karasuno High's volleyball team
yuu-nishinoya.notes: Episode 7 and chapter 15 ("Chemical Reaction", a brief appearance; he appears properly in chapter 16, "Another Prodigy") rest on the Haikyu!! Wiki. The Wikipedia summary of episode 7 mentions Karasuno's returning libero without naming him; episode 8 is the first to name him.
yuu-nishinoya.abilities: Karasuno's libero, a short but fearless defensive specialist with lightning reflexes who can receive almost any spike.

fate.detail: Nobody dies in Haikyu!!; after the timeskip Nishinoya has quit volleyball to travel the world (he is in Italy during the final arc).

chainsaw-man-reze.name: Reze
chainsaw-man-reze.role: Girl working at a cafe who befriends Denji
chainsaw-man-reze.notes: Chapter 40 is confirmed by both sources. Her episode 12 appearance is a short scene at the end of the TV series per the Chainsaw Man Wiki (AniList also lists her in the TV series); Wikipedia's episode summary does not name her. Her main anime appearance is the 2025 film Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc. Affiliations left out to avoid spoilers.
chainsaw-man-reze.abilities: Introduced as a friendly cafe worker Denji meets while sheltering from the rain; she turns out to be far more dangerous than she looks.

fate.detail: At the end of the Reze arc (manga chapter 52; Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc, 2025) she is mortally wounded by the Angel Devil under Makima's orders, but she later reappears under Makima's control and is freed after Makima's death; her whereabouts are unknown.

nami.name: Nami
nami.role: Navigator of the Straw Hat Pirates and a skilled thief

debut.episodeTitle: I'm Gonna Be King of the Pirates!

nami.notes: Chapter 8 ("Nami") is confirmed by both sources; she is also on the chapter 1 cover. Episode 1 rests on the One Piece Wiki; the Wikipedia summary of episode 1 does not name her. Arcs listed are the East Blue arcs. Her earlier affiliation is left out to avoid spoilers.
nami.abilities: The Straw Hats' navigator, who can read the weather and sea with uncanny skill, draws maps and is a talented thief; she fights with a staff.

fate.detail: Nami is alive in the anime and the ongoing manga (as of November 2026).

gyro-zeppeli.name: Gyro Zeppeli
gyro-zeppeli.role: Neapolitan rider in the Steel Ball Run race who fights with spinning steel balls

debut.anime: Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken

gyro-zeppeli.notes: Episode 1 (the "1st Stage", released on Netflix on March 19, 2026) is confirmed by both sources. Chapter 1 of Steel Ball Run and his father rest on the JoJo Wiki.
gyro-zeppeli.abilities: A Neapolitan executioner and master of the Spin, which channels rotational energy through steel balls, backed by deep medical knowledge.

fate.detail: Funny Valentine kills him during their battle near the end of the race, after D4C Love Train turns a wound back on him (Steel Ball Run manga).

ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.name: Ray
ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.role: One of the three eldest and smartest orphans at Grace Field House, with Emma and Norman
ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.notes: Chapter 1 ("Grace Field House") is confirmed by both sources. Episode 1 rests on the Promised Neverland Wiki episode page; the Wikipedia summary of episode 1 names only Emma and Norman. Relatives left out to avoid spoilers.
ray-cc6835fa-42f9-482a-b3d8-ba3d9ea23727.abilities: A genius orphan at Grace Field House and Norman's equal in intelligence, an avid reader who is skilled at planning and secretly knows the truth about the farm.

fate.detail: Ray survives the series and is alive at the end of the manga (2020) and the anime's second season (2021); the author has said Ray was originally going to die.

jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.name: Toge Inumaki
jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.role: Second-year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High who uses Cursed Speech and talks only in rice ball ingredients
jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.notes: Episode 5 is confirmed by both sources. Chapter 10 rests on the Jujutsu Kaisen Wiki; both sources agree he first appeared in the prequel Jujutsu Kaisen 0.
jujutsu-kaisen-toge-inumaki.abilities: A semi-Grade 1 sorcerer who uses Cursed Speech to make people obey spoken commands, so he talks only in rice-ball fillings to avoid hurting anyone.

fate.detail: He loses his left arm to Sukuna in the Shibuya Incident but survives and is alive at the series' end (manga chapter 271, 2024).
